sys_ux_event.description: Fires when the user confirms the share panel for a pinned item. The component only COLLECTS recipients — persisting or notifying is the page's job (there is no sharing table yet). Payload: { table, sysId, label, url, item, recipients, userSysIds, groupSysIds }.
sys_ux_event.label: Pinned item shared
sys_ux_event.props: [ { "description": "Table of the shared record.", "fieldType": "string", "label": "Table", "name": "table", "valueType": "string" }, { "description": "sys_id of the shared record.", "fieldType": "string", "label": "Record Sys ID", "name": "sysId", "valueType": "string" }, { "description": "Title of the shared pinned item.", "fieldType": "string", "label": "Label", "name": "label", "valueType": "string" }, { "description": "Resolved record URL, ready to drop into a notification.", "fieldType": "string", "label": "URL", "name": "url", "valueType": "string" }, { "description": "The full stored item: { table, sysId, label, sublabel, url, pinnedAt, data }.", "fieldType": "json", "label": "Pinned item", "name": "item", "valueType": "string" }, { "description": "[{ type: 'user'|'group', sysId, name }] in the order they were picked.", "fieldType": "json", "label": "Recipients", "name": "recipients", "valueType": "string" }, { "description": "Just the user sys_ids — convenient for a notification or an m2m insert.", "fieldType": "json", "label": "User Sys IDs", "name": "userSysIds", "valueType": "string" }, { "description": "Just the group sys_ids.", "fieldType": "json", "label": "Group Sys IDs", "name": "groupSysIds", "valueType": "string" } ]
